The '''E-500 Micro-pulse Annihilator''' was a type of portable [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] produced during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="The Old Republic" />
